dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: There's only a handful of monsters blocking the way ahead — surely I won't need to personally make an appearance...?

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Um... Heh, I mean, I did read your report, it's just... Okay, perhaps they do look a little tough, yes, but mostly... I'm just not feeling up to fighting today...

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: ...No, of course I'm not afraid of them! ...Fine, fine! If you insist on performing as a duo, then I shall indulge you.
